Radius/control (4 px, all viewports) is bound by ~45 sets with unrelated jobs: Checkbox family (must stay square), the tag family (Badge Shape=rounded, Kbd, InputTagChip, InputTag tag, Input/AppHeader Kbd, Field trailing), TextLink and Breadcrumb focus rings, Slider (SliderThumb, track, fill, thumb, tooltip), media (AvatarGroup, _AvatarPhoto, ScrollArea image, TableMediaCell). The generator's Selectors axis drives it, so raising it for badges turns a 16 px checkbox into a circle (reads as Radio) from 8 px up. Code caps Checkbox at 25 % of its side in the recipe (box classification §4.2), which makes it harmless; the split itself is Figma's call (names are Figma's). Options: (a) move the tag family to the existing Radius/item; (b) add a new tag role in the file; (c) keep as is and rely on the code cap. Recommended: (a). Board: 🧪 Experiments page.
